finding.title: Keep worker resilient when its upstream is unavailable
finding.summary: A temporary upstream connection failure returned no response and crashed the worker loop.
evidence: The upstream connection was refused immediately before the worker exception.
The worker dereferenced a missing response without checking it.
finding.suspected_cause: The worker assumes the upstream call always returns a response object.
finding.recommended_fix: Handle a missing response without terminating the loop and add regression coverage for upstream failures.
